A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DyBBT research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E are readable and sufficiently complete for reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original DyBBT benchmark results and ablations, alongside human evaluation and real-user experiments in Tables 4–5.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark, ablation, human-evaluation and real-user results, including the supplementary analyses in Appendix E.

M1.justification: The cognitive features, dual-trigger controller, S1 supervised/PPO training, S2 three-path reasoning and knowledge-distillation procedure are unchanged. Added explanations of the three-dimensional representation introduce no new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MS Dialog Movie, Restaurant and Taxi tasks, MultiWOZ 2.1 coverage, and human and real-user scenarios. No dataset, domain, population or task requirement is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same methods, including the DQN variants, LLM_DP, EIERL and MultiWOZ comparators AutoTOD, ProTOD and MACRM. Human-study comparators and the Qwen3 mode configurations also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Splits, preprocessing, metrics, simulators, model configurations and study designs are retained. Both versions specify 500/10,000 training epochs and 30/40-turn limits, with the same thresholds and human-study sample sizes in Appendices B–D.

E4.justification: Table 2's component and cognitive-feature ablations, the sensitivity tests, controller analyses, error categories and appendix case studies are unchanged. The added discussion of the cognitive-state design supplies no new analysis results.

E5.justification: Appendix B.5 retains the same five fixed random seeds. Table 8 still reports standard deviations over five seeds, and the uncertainty reporting in the human, real-user and mode-comparison tables is unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 6 retains success rates of 84.1 for DyBBT-8B and 85.3 for DyBBT-8B/GPT-4.0; Table 2 retains 83.2 for the learned cognitive-state variant. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Assumptions 3.1 and A.1, regret expression and Appendix A.2 derivation are unchanged. The added dim(C) = 3 statement repeats Appendix A.1; the classical-discretization explanation changes framing rather than mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about cognitive-state formulation, adaptive dual-system control, state-of-the-art performance, generalization and alignment with human judgment.

C2.justification: Sections 3.2 and 5.1 more explicitly defend the fixed cognitive state as an expressiveness-versus-tractability trade-off. Section 5.1 additionally interprets the existing ablations as supporting near-optimal performance. The previously documented failure modes and applicability limitations remain.

D1.justification: Page 1 changes the stated code-access location from an anonymous repository link to a named GitHub repository. Appendix B's prompts, implementation details and hyperparameters are unchanged; repository functionality cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The reference list is unchanged, but Section 3.1.3 now explicitly identifies the analysis as adapting classical discretization arguments and locates novelty in the cognitive-state formulation and controller criteria. The methodology opening also adopts the more qualified phrase 'theoretically motivated framework'.

P1.justification: v3 adds localized explanatory paragraphs and an Acknowledgments section, revises author and affiliation information, and makes grammar and hyphenation edits. The main narrative and appendix organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: The author block is compacted and text and floats reflow; for example, Table 10 moves from page 30 to page 31. All eight figures and eleven tables are retained. Figure 3's Restaurant panel label gains punctuation, while the plotted graphics remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves explanatory clarity by identifying the classical basis of its analysis and making the cognitive-state design rationale explicit. The named code location also improves attribution. These gains are limited: the evidence and mathematical reasoning are unchanged, and the added near-optimality interpretation goes beyond what the retained ablations establish.
